process.detail: A recent electricity bill and your roof orientation tells us most of what we need for a guide price.
Panel layout, inverter, and what it will actually save you. Fixed price in writing.
Most homes are a day on the roof. We handle the grid application and the paperwork.

faq.q: How much will it save me?
faq.a: It depends on how much power you use during the day. We work it out from your actual bill rather than a brochure figure.
Sometimes. It depends on your usage pattern and your feed-in tariff. We will run your numbers and tell you if the answer is no.
They change, and they differ by state. We apply the current ones to your quote and show you the number before and after.

faq.q: What if my roof is shaded?
faq.a: Shade matters more than most people expect. We will tell you straight if your roof is not a good candidate.
